title: Adaptive slot gating and probabilistic fidelity fallback for OOM resilience
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a tenant- and request-aware admission controller that enforces slot budgets at batch admission time and triggers a probabilistic fidelity fallback pipeline to avoid GPU OOMs. The feature combines: (1) slot-aware batch trimming to limit KV and activation reservations per incoming request, (2) lightweight KV snapshotting to persist hot KV segments to host memory when headroom is low, (3) a stochastic fidelity controller that can select cheaper model variants or quantized paths with an adjustable probability depending on current pressure, and (4) deterministic retry/backoff with canary warming and request hedging to preserve request success rates. Goal: reduce OOM incidence by >90% on tail workloads while keeping median latency regression <10% and percent-long-tail SLOs intact.
acceptance_criteria: Slot admission enforces per-request memory reservation; admission rejections fall <0.5% after tuning
On synthetic tail test, OOMs reduced by >=90% compared to baseline
Median latency increase <=10% and p99 latency increase <=25% under mixed load
End-to-end observability dashboard shows slot usage, fallback rate, and KV snapshot events
Graceful retries return final success for >=99% of requests that initially hit fallback (within 3 retries)
comments: 2026-02-20 Maya Chen: Created ticket after postmortem of incident 2026-02-18 where a burst of long-context requests triggered multiple OOMs. Initial hypothesis: concurrent KV growth + large batch admission without per-request limits.
2026-02-23 Rafael Soto: Spike experiment v1 with coarse slot caps reduced OOMs on stage by 60% but increased tail latency ~30%. Need finer-grained per-tenant slot calculation and softer degradation.
2026-02-28 Priya Nair (SRE): Observability hooks added for per-request KV reservation and evictions. Dashboard panels validate the reservation counters per GPU.

2026-03-03 Rafael Soto: Implemented probabilistic fidelity controller prototype (beta): under pressure, 20% of requests are downgraded to quantized model path; this reduced p95 memory by 18% with small quality signal regression. Need A/B tests for user-visible regressions.

2026-03-06 Design review (Ana Gomez): UX for Console exposes 'slot budget' and 'fallback aggressiveness' per deployment; recommended default safeties and a 'disaster mode' slider for emergency degradation.
2026-03-08 Performance notes (bench): End-to-end bench on p4d-like nodes: synthetic mix (50% long-context) OOM rate baseline 7.4% -> with slot gating + KV snapshot 0.6%, median latency +6%, p99 +18%.

2026-03-10 Rafael Soto: Merging PR 9876 to staging. Next steps: expand KV snapshot tests to multi-tenant noise, tune stochastic controller temperature, and add deterministic retry policy with hedging to reduce false negatives.
